relations.subject: 15th Karmapa
relations.evidence: The 1st Beru Khyentse had many non-sectarian disciples from the Sakya, Gelug, Kagyu and Nyingma traditions. Some from the Kagyu school were the 15th Karmapa (he was both his Guru as well as his disciple)
